family_context_source.selected_text:
1st Official Pokemon Card Game Tournament
The 1st Official Pokemon Card Game Tournament is often considered the first official tournament for the Pokemon TCG.
The tournament was held from June 14 – 15, 1997.
The No.1 Trainer (Pokemon Card Game Official Tournament 1997) card was awarded to 1st place winners across each of the 4 tournament sessions. Only 4 copies of the card were given out.
No.1 Trainer (Pokemon Card Game Official Tournament 1997) (Unnumbered)
The No.2 Trainer (Pokemon Card Game Official Tournament 1997) card was awarded to 2nd place winners across each of the 4 tournament sessions. Only 4 copies of the card were given out.
No.2 Trainer (Pokemon Card Game Official Tournament 1997) (Unnumbered)
The No.3 Trainer (Pokemon Card Game Official Tournament 1997) card was awarded to 3rd place winners across each of the 4 tournament sessions. Only 4 copies of the card were given out.
No.3 Trainer (Pokemon Card Game Official Tournament 1997) (Unnumbered)
Winners of each of the 4 tournament sessions each received a No.1-3 Trainer trophy card.
The 1st official tournament No.1-3 trainer cards and trophies are often confused with Charizard Mega Battle No. 1-3 Trainer cards.
